The following is the beginning of a story. Write and complete the story. Make your story as interesting
as possible.

When we arrived at school that morning, two women and a man were talking to the headteacher beside
a car parked outside the office. When the car left, the headteacher announced that our school had been

nominated the cleanest in the county. The County Director of Education would be sponsoring a school
trip the following Saturday...
